sites.name: Connecting Ridge
sites.notes: Crest of the ridge joining Shackleton and de Gerlache craters, at one of the most often sunlit points near the pole (point C1 of Gläser et al. 2018).

sites.name: Shackleton crater rim
sites.notes: The most often sunlit point on the rim of Shackleton crater, about 7 km from the pole (point S of Gläser et al. 2018).

sites.name: Peak near Shackleton
sites.notes: Top of an isolated peak on the far side of Shackleton, about 36 km from the pole (point SV1 of De Rosa et al. 2012).

sites.name: de Gerlache crater rim
sites.notes: On the rim of de Gerlache crater (point GR1 of De Rosa et al. 2012).

sites.name: Malapert Massif
sites.notes: High on Mons Malapert, a near-side massif about 5 km above the reference sphere (point MP1 of De Rosa et al. 2012).

sites.name: IM-2 Athena landing site, Mons Mouton
sites.mission: Intuitive Machines IM-2 (Athena lander), NASA CLPS
sites.notes: Where the lander came to rest, on its side in a crater about 20 m across, on the plateau of Mons Mouton (LROC, 10 March 2025).

sites.name: Shackleton crater floor
sites.notes: Centre of Shackleton crater, about 4 km below its rim (Zuber et al. 2012). The crater's interior holds a permanently shadowed region (Tye et al. 2015).

sites.name: Haworth crater floor
sites.notes: Centre of Haworth crater, 51 km across (USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature). The crater's interior holds a permanently shadowed region (Tye et al. 2015).

sites.name: Faustini crater floor
sites.notes: Centre of Faustini crater, 42 km across (USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature). The crater's interior holds a permanently shadowed region (Tye et al. 2015).

sites.name: LCROSS impact site, Cabeus crater
sites.notes: Where the LCROSS Centaur stage struck a permanently shadowed region on the floor of Cabeus crater (Marshall et al. 2011).
